name: tsa_validateOtp
description: Checks an OTP hash against the newest unused, unexpired TSA.OtpCode for the phone, marks it used on a match, and returns the Active worker id for that phone (NULL when not yet registered) so the caller can choose registration or return-session. Currently unused while the app runs the tsa_loginByPhone bypass. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'validateOtp' to [TSA].[tsa_validateOtp]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: otpHash
parameters.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the code entered. No default.

columns.name: workerId
columns.description: Active TSA.Worker.id for the phone; NULL for a first-time registration.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: No matching code (line 37, 'Invalid or expired code. Please try again.') or CATCH (line 60). Two columns only.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed user-facing text, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block (raw SQL Server text).

sideEffects: UPDATE TSA.OtpCode SET usedAt = now on the matched code.

codeSmells.detail: @phoneNumber, @otpHash (lines 2-3) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.
The CATCH (lines 58-61) returns the error envelope but writes nothing to HC.ErrorLog or any TSA log table, so failures are only visible in Azure Function logs as a 400 warning.
A wrong code does not consume or count against the OTP, so the 10-minute window allows unlimited guesses of a 6-digit code (and GET needs no key).

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
